title: cenolophium denudatum
intro: Cenolophium denudatum, commonly known as Naked Marjoram, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cenolophium denudatum are attributed to its ability to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, phenolic compounds, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
